newsitem.title: USA: Guitar Center prices public offering.
newsitem.headline: Guitar Center prices public offering.

text.p: Guitar Center Inc said Thursday it had priced its initial public offering of 6,750,000 shares of common stock at $15 a share.
The shares which were offered by the company will begin trading on Nasdaq on March 14.

Goldman, Sachs & Co., Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, Montgomery Securities, Dain Bosworth Inc and Chase Securities Inc were the managing underwriters in the offering. The company has granted the underwriters an overallotment option to purchase up to an additional 1,102,500 shares of common stock which may be exercised by the within 30 days following the pricing of the offering.
